newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB sets 13-wk bill auction at 12.4 pct. [CORRECTED 23:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB sets 13-wk bill auction at 12.4 pct. [CORRECTED 23:57 GMT]

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Wednesday announced an auction offering three billion crowns in 13-week central bank liquidity bills to be held on Thursday.
Bids in the Dutch auction will be limited to a maximum gross yield of 12.4 percent.

In the previous auction of similar bills last week, yield was 12.4 percent, down (corrects from up) from 12.75 percent on January 9, but the offer of five billion crowns was undersubscribed with bids totalling 1.76 billion crowns.
